Questions and answers

Can't find yours? Ask us.

Is Aether really free?

Yes. No subscription, no paid cosmetics and no ads. Every feature is available to everyone.

Which devices does it work on?

Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iPhone and iPad (by sideloading), and any modern browser at the web app. Your account, chats and settings are the same everywhere. See Download.

Are my messages private?

Chats are only visible to the people in them. For extra privacy, turn on end-to-end encryption in a DM or group: messages and files are then encrypted on your device and nobody else, including us, can read them. You can also make messages disappear after a while. More in our privacy page.

How do calls work?

Voice and video go directly between the people in the call (peer-to-peer), encrypted, never through our servers. Because of that, calls with more than about 6 people use more of your bandwidth. A few very strict networks block direct connections; if calls never connect there, you can add your own relay (TURN) server in Settings → Voice & Audio.

What are Moments?

Photos, short videos or text notes that disappear after 24 hours. Each one can be shared with everyone you know, your friends, or your close friends. You can see who viewed yours.

How do I change the layout or theme?

Settings → Appearance. Pick Classic, Orbit, Lounge or Workspace, or choose Custom to drag and resize every panel. Each layout has its own themes. Rumour has it some themes need a secret code.

Does translation or transcription send my messages somewhere?

No. Both run on your device. The first time, your device downloads the language model once (it's then cached). In Chrome, the browser's built-in translator is used and can translate into many languages; elsewhere, translating into English is supported.

Does Aether see what games I play?

On Windows, the desktop app checks which of your installed games is running so it can show it as your status. Only the game's name and when you started are shared, and only while you have game activity turned on. You can hide your play history or clear it in Settings → Activity Privacy.

Why does Windows or macOS warn me when I install it?

The apps aren't signed with paid certificates yet, so Windows SmartScreen and macOS show a warning the first time. On Windows choose More info → Run anyway; on macOS right-click → Open. After that it updates itself normally.

Can I build a bot?

Yes. Create an app in Settings → Developer, copy its token, and post messages through the bot API. Add slash commands and Aether sends them to your server as signed requests. Server managers add apps in Server settings → Bots & apps.

How do I get my data or delete my account?

Settings → My Account has Download my data (a file with everything you've made) and Delete account.

I found a bug or have an idea.

In the app: Settings → Report a bug (it can include a screenshot). Or use the contact form.
